thesis: Q3 confirmed accelerating, cash-generative growth (revenue +8.9% YoY, net income +89% YoY, FCF 195.1M against 25.9M debt, forward P/E 15.1). The 11-05 post-earnings gap has held for two weeks on lighter-volume consolidation just under the 37.21 52-week high, and the stock sits in the health-care group that is leading the risk-off tape. Reward/risk is 1.67 at the 35.75 zone midpoint against the 33.2 stop. That clears the bar only for a dip entry, so this is a modest, pullback-only position and not a chase at 36.16 (about 1.3 R/R).
invalidation: A daily close below 33.3 (the 11-06 post-earnings low) negates the setup, and a close below 32.03 back inside the gap means the earnings breakout has failed.
key_risks: Risk-off regime (confidence 0.85, QQQ ret_21 -8.1%, VIX percentile 0.858) raises the odds of a gap-fill in momentum names
